title: Aquatarium

services.name: Aq Exhibits
services.desc: Discover the family wonderland inside the Aquatarium! Our facility is filled with endless fun for kids, creating memories that will last a lifetime. From immersive exhibits to play structures to wildlife, you'll find something new around every corner! Notice: Our primary elevator is out of service until further notice. Please ask a staff member for directions to the alternate elevator or stairs. Note that the 4th floor exhibit is only accessible by stairs, but the 3rd floor remains accessible via the alternate elevator. Children 12 years and under MUST be accompanied by a paying adult at ALL times. Infants (2 years & under) are free to attend the Aquatarium with their guardian who has paid
